title: margaye muslim ke pisar haaye  haaye
body:
margaye muslim ke pisar haaye haaye
kargaye dunya se safar haaye haaye
haris-e maloon ki bedaad se
hil gaye seeno me jigar haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid se chut kar bhi na paai amaa'n
aagaye qatil hi ke ghar haaye haaye
kaat liya bacho ke sar roosiyah
kuch na kiya qoufo qatar haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
dono yateemo ke badan nehr me
daaldiya baanie shar haaye haaye
bhaanje abbase dilawar ke haaye
zib'ha hue tashnajigar haaye haaye
